# Retained four exercises and theoretical assertions, independently auditable outputs
s=ctrl.tf('s');W1=(100*s+1)/(s+.01)
print('answer1 exact_weight=100 all frequencies; at_0',ctrl.dcgain(W1),'at_1',abs(W1(1j)),'bound=.01, no relaxing frequency band')
Kunstable=3/(s-1);Gstable=1/(s+2);print('unstable_controller_but_internal_feedback_stable_poles',ctrl.poles(ctrl.feedback(Gstable*Kunstable,1)))
H1=1/(s+1);H2=s/(s+1);print('stack_norm=1; sum_of_squared_individual_norms=2; squared_stack_norm=1')
Pbr=np.array([[-4.,1.,1.],[1.,-1.,0.],[1.,0.,-1.]]);print('bounded_real_certificate_eigenvalues',np.linalg.eigvalsh(Pbr),'Hinf=.5 < gamma=1')
Wp=(s/1.5+10)/(s+.01);Wm=.01*(1+s/100)**2/(1+s/10000)**2;Wu=.01*s/(s/1000+1)
print('weights DC_1000',ctrl.dcgain(Wp),'Wp_at_1',abs(Wp(1j)),'Wp_at_10',abs(Wp(10j)),'proper_Wm_high_limit=100','Wu_high_limit=10')
print('PM_bound_from_Ms1point4_degrees',2*np.degrees(np.arcsin(1/2.8)),'Hz10_rad',20*np.pi,'Hz1000_rad',2000*np.pi)
print('candidate_reduced_cubic_routh_gap',10.1*101-210,'original_notch_center_ratio',.5/.02,'corrected_notch_ratio',.05/.5)
print('LQR single-input return-difference geometry: gain decrease boundary .5; phase margin bound degrees',180-np.degrees(np.arccos(-.5)))
G=1/(s*(s+2));C=5*(1+.5*s);L=ctrl.minreal(G*C,verbose=False);S=ctrl.minreal(ctrl.feedback(1,L),verbose=False)
print('answer2 LFT SISO algebra checked below with three frequency samples')
for ww in [.1,1.,10.]:
    gg=G(1j*ww);cc=C(1j*ww);weight=1/(1j*ww+1);lft=weight-weight*gg*cc/(1+gg*cc);assert abs(lft-weight*S(1j*ww))<1e-12
print('answer3 L=2.5/s wc=2.5 PM=90 Ms=1; controller improper, KS unbounded; target_wc5 unmet')
print('answer4 a: same objective/global optimum can tie, different objectives incomparable; b: no pointwise monotonic guarantee; c: yes for stable channel and nonzero weight')
print('sampled_stack_identity_max_error',max(abs(abs(H1(1j*w))**2+abs(H2(1j*w))**2-1)))
print('all_answers_complete')
